answer_1.quote: LLMs should understand user instructions and accurately call external tools to provide informative responses.
answer_1.outputs: Generated text responses to user instructions

answer_2.quote: Evaluation Metrics. For helpfulness instructions, we evaluate LLMs responses by utilizing ToolEval in ToolBench. In ToolEval, we report the Pass Rate (PR), which evaluates whether LLMs responses complete the instructions, and the Win Rate (WR), which makes a lose-win decision over LLMs responses compared to ChatGPT responses.

answer_3.quote: We then prompt ChatGPT to evaluate the quality of these two responses to obtain the preferences.

answer_4.quote: To verify the agreement between GPT-4 scores and human scores, we randomly select 50 responses from each testset and provide humans with scoring criteria (detailed criteria can be found in the Table and Table of the appendix) for evaluating the helpfulness of the responses.
answer_4.guideline: Scoring criteria for helpfulness from the appendix
